ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN accountType ENUM('consumer', 'business_owner') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'consumer';

ALTER TABLE businesses ADD COLUMN brandsCarried TEXT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partnership_emails (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  senderUserId INT NOT NULL,
  senderBusinessId INT,
  recipientBusinessId INT NOT NULL,
  recipientEmail VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  subject VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('sent', 'delivered', 'failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_tickets (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT,
  userName VARCHAR(255),
  userEmail VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  ticketType ENUM('bug', 'feature_request', 'general') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  screenshotUrls TEXT,
  status ENUM('new', 'in_backlog', 'in_progress', 'in_testing', 'done', 'launched') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  adminNotes TEXT,
  resolvedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_approvals (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT,
  categoryType ENUM('sport', 'business_type', 'region', 'hub') NOT NULL,
  proposedName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  proposedSlug VARCHAR(255),
  parentRegion VARCHAR(100),
  description TEXT,
  status ENUM('pending', 'approved', 'rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  adminNotes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO businessTypes (name, slug, description, icon) VALUES
  ('Supplement Retailer', 'supplement-retailer', 'Sports nutrition supplement retailers carrying brands like Feed, Ketone IQ, Tailwind, Scratch, Momentus, Pillar', '💊'),
  ('Bike Retailer', 'bike-retailer', 'Bicycle retailers and dealers carrying major bike brands and OEMs', '🚲')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description);

INSERT INTO platform_stats (stat_key, stat_value) VALUES ('partnership_emails', 156) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stat_value = VALUES(stat_value);
